interface: GPIO digital HIGH/LOW, same firmware path as PIR; 1.8-5.5 V, ~3 uA in low-power mode

measurands.name: present
measurands.accuracy: proximity/touch within ~2-3 cm of the electrode; not room-scale presence

failure_modes: long-held object fades into baseline: the IC recalibrates it away (timeout is configuration-dependent); treat very long constant 'present' with mild suspicion
sensitivity shifts with electrode geometry and nearby grounded metal; re-tune after any mechanical change
false triggers from water films on the electrode surface
mounting: electrode pad under the surface where the object rests; keep high-voltage wiring away from the electrode
